text: 【印尼央行：人民币占本币交易逾八成 拟进一步扩大对华结算合作】印尼央行计划近期进一步落实并扩大与中国内地及香港的本币交易(LCT)合作，以建立完整的印尼盾与人民币货币及外汇市场生态。印尼央行表示，2026年6月，印尼盾与人民币交易约占LCT交易总额的81%。这一增长“表明，印尼盾与人民币直接结算作为经由第三方货币进行交易的替代方式，重要性正日益上升”。
text_en: Indonesia Central Bank: RMB Accounts for Over 80% of Local Currency Transactions; Plans to Expand Settlement Cooperation with China. Indonesia's central bank plans to further implement and expand local currency transaction (LCT) cooperation with mainland China and Hong Kong in the near term, aiming to build a complete IDR-RMB currency and forex market ecosystem. The central bank stated that in June 2026, IDR-RMB transactions accounted for approximately 81% of total LCT transactions. This growth "indicates that direct settlement between the IDR and RMB is increasingly important as an alternative to transactions conducted via third-party currencies."
